purpose: Record the current BTC perpetual research proxy, cost model, risk defaults, source trail, and decisions that remain open. This is not a live trading configuration.

research_proxy.status: provisional research proxy only; not user-confirmed for execution

must_capture_from_exchange_info_before_v: quantity step, minimum quantity and LOT_SIZE
minimum notional and applicable order filters

order_and_fee_policy.strategy_entry_policy: A limit order is placed at the next-bar open plus 2 bp for a long or minus 2 bp for a short; it is canceled if it remains unresolved after the next execution bar, subject to unverified cancel/fill race behavior.
order_and_fee_policy.classification_rule: A fill that immediately matches resting book liquidity is taker. A fill is maker only to the extent its order rested and added liquidity before matching. Classify actual executions per fill, not from the order's LIMIT label.
order_and_fee_policy.research_fee_classification: Assume taker fees on the marketable entry and protective exits until fill-level evidence shows otherwise. Do not credit maker rates to a marketable limit.
order_and_fee_policy.backtest_commission_status: Unverified placeholder inherited from strategy runs; not the user's Binance fee rate.
order_and_fee_policy.user_account_fee_status: unknown; account rate depends on user-specific fee tier/discount and should be read from the user's fee page or authenticated user-commission endpoint. Do not share API keys or secrets.
order_and_fee_policy.official_fee_page_note: Binance's documentation gives example rates for fee calculations and directs users to the account fee table; those examples are not treated as the user's current rates.

round_trip_scenarios.note: The retained 10 bp diagnostic equals the backtest's assumed 5 bp commission on entry and exit; it leaves spread, adverse slippage and funding unmeasured.
Existing B0 setting; not a verified realized round-trip cost and not fully debited from native strategy P&L.
Stress case only; no evidence says this equals the venue's actual cost.

cost_components.scenario_convention: 10/15/20 bp are non-funding round-trip execution-cost sensitivities, not venue quotes. The 15 bp value remains frozen; do not lower any case to create more trades. Funding is a separate signed position cash flow.

spread.measurement_plan: Capture synchronized best bid/ask at decision and order/fill times; record relative spread in basis points. A current snapshot alone is not historical spread evidence.

adverse_slippage.measurement_plan: Compare each actual fill with the executable-side quote/midpoint frozen at order submission, weighted by fill notional; retain latency and partial fills. The 2 bp limit price offset is a bound, not observed slippage.

funding.accounting_policy: Apply the actual signed funding cash flow only when a position is held at a recorded funding settlement. Keep funding separate from trade execution bps and do not assume a fixed interval or zero charge.
funding.historical_source: Binance USDⓈ-M BTCUSDT funding-rate history and current funding-info endpoints; not yet ingested into this project.

cost_components.net_pnl_reconciliation: Native TakeProfit backtests already charge their configured commission. When applying a total execution-cost scenario to a native P&L ledger, add only missing spread/slippage components; when using a gross-price external ledger, deduct the scenario's full fee+spread+slippage once. Add funding once in either case.

risk_and_account.status: Provisional project research policy, not confirmed as the user's acceptable personal risk. Native daily/equity locks are not implemented or verified.
risk_and_account.risk_lock_note: The 4R daily and 8% drawdown values are proposed research gates inherited from the implementation plan. Preserve protective exits if an entry lock is triggered; do not claim a cash proxy is equity.

holding_time_and_profiles.interpretation: Execution timeframe is not a holding-time promise. Report durations separately by profile until the user defines a maximum scalp duration.

deployment_gates: User confirms an execution venue and exact contract, or explicitly continues with Binance only as a research proxy.
Actual maker/taker account rates are recorded; unresolved fills are costed as taker for research.
Live contract filters are captured and entry/stop/target prices and quantity are rounded then risk is recalculated.
Historical spread/slippage evidence and funding cash flows are added without double-counting native commission.
User confirms account notional, acceptable per-trade risk, daily loss/drawdown limits, and desired maximum holding time.
No live order automation until the remaining data, parity, execution and costed-performance checkpoints pass.
user_decisions_remaining: Keep Binance USDⓈ-M BTCUSDT as the research proxy or name another venue/contract.
Provide account maker/taker rates and any applicable discounts, or leave them unknown; no credentials are needed.
Confirm or replace the provisional $10,000 research notional, 0.25% risk per trade, 4R daily loss proposal and 8% drawdown proposal.
Specify the intended maximum holding duration; current strategy has no timed exit.
